name: pr-review
title: PR review
description: 4 times a day: code and security review of every open pull request by Claude Fable, counter-review of the replies in its threads, and resolution of its own fixed outdated threads.
notes: Reviews are posted by the reviewer app (review_app) so they can approve pull requests opened by bot_app. The review runs in a subagent on the Fable model and outdated threads are checked by a Sonnet subagent: both models must be available to the account. PROFILE.md must fill Code review checklist, Security review checklist and the static checks for pull request files in Safe commands.
